```{r, load packages and working directory}

source("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\code\\R\\plotting.R")


elev_z_wind_slope_flux <- readr::read_csv("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\elev_z_wind_slope_flux.csv")

```

```{r, build tiers}
source("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\code\\R\\tier_filtering.R")

# Tier <-> (site_scope, flag_criterion), in filtering order:
#   tier1 <- noG,  review_only
#   tier2 <- noG2, review_only
#   tier3 <- all,  review_only
#   tier4 <- noG2, full
#   tier5 <- all,  full
#   tier6 <- noG,  full

master_tier1 <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_flux, "noG",  "review_only")
master_tier2 <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_flux, "noG2", "review_only")
master_tier3 <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_flux, "all",  "review_only")
master_tier4 <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_flux, "noG2", "full")
master_tier5 <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_flux, "all",  "full")
master_tier6 <- filter_flux(elev_z_wind_slope_flux, "noG",  "full")

save_tier(master_tier1, "master_tier1.csv")
save_tier(master_tier2, "master_tier2.csv")
save_tier(master_tier3, "master_tier3.csv")
save_tier(master_tier4, "master_tier4.csv")
save_tier(master_tier5, "master_tier5.csv")
save_tier(master_tier6, "master_tier6.csv")
```

```{r, tier statistics}
 # for make_flux_table()
source("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\code\\R\\flux_summary.R")

tiers <- list(tier1 = master_tier1, tier2 = master_tier2, tier3 = master_tier3,
              tier4 = master_tier4, tier5 = master_tier5, tier6 = master_tier6)

tier_general <- purrr::imap(tiers, ~ make_flux_table(
  .x, title = paste("Summary Statistics —", .y), include_ci = TRUE))

tier_phen <- purrr::imap(tiers, ~ make_flux_table(
  .x, group_vars = "Phen_Period", title = paste("Flux by Phenological Period —", .y),
  group_labels = list(Phen_Period = "Phenological Period")))

tier_site <- purrr::imap(tiers, ~ make_flux_table(
  .x, group_vars = "Site", title = paste("Flux by Site —", .y),
  group_labels = list(Site = "Site")))

# Note: kept as Date.removed.from.field per original tier code (this was
# labeled "phase_summary_tier*" in the old chunks but never actually
# grouped by Study.Phase -- see Session_Status "misleading name" note).
tier_removal_date <- purrr::imap(tiers, ~ make_flux_table(
  .x, group_vars = "Date.removed.from.field",
  title = paste("Flux by Date Removed From Field —", .y),
  group_labels = list(Date.removed.from.field = "Date Removed From Field")))

# access e.g. tier_general$tier1$table, tier_phen$tier5$data, etc.
tier_general$tier1$table

```

```{r, tier plots}


tier_plots <- purrr::imap(tiers, ~ make_sed_plots(
  .x, title_suffix = paste0(" (", .y, ")")))
# Date.removed.from.field is now the default phase_var, so no need to
# pass it explicitly -- kept here only if you ever want a tier to use
# a different grouping.

# access e.g. tier_plots$tier1$basic, tier_plots$tier4$phase_site, etc.
# z* plot (elev_site, colored by Site) is included automatically for any
# tier whose data has a z_star column.
tier_plots$tier1$basic
```

```{r, rq plots}
# make_rq_plots() itself now lives in R/plotting.R (sourced above).
# All six tiers included -- the original code left out one review_only
# tier from this section for no clear reason; flag if that was
# actually intentional and you want it excluded here too.

rq_tiers <- list(tier1 = master_tier1, tier2 = master_tier2, tier3 = master_tier3,
                  tier4 = master_tier4, tier5 = master_tier5, tier6 = master_tier6)

rq_plots <- purrr::imap(rq_tiers, ~ make_rq_plots(.x, .y))

# access e.g. rq_plots$tier1$edge, rq_plots$tier5$slope, etc.
rq_plots$tier1$interval
```
